as first from_json first/first.json
as second from_json second/second.json

# deepmerge
as merged deepmerge @first $second
to_json @merged
as replaced deepmerge @first $second --lists replace
equals @merged $replaced
as joined deepmerge @first $second --lists concat
to_json @joined
as united deepmerge @first $second --lists union
to_json @united
as back deepmerge @second $first
to_json @back
as same deepmerge @first $first
equals @first $same
as none obj
as onto deepmerge @none $first
equals @first $onto
as under deepmerge @first $none
equals @first $under
deepmerge @none $none

# deepmerge: what it refuses
deepmerge @first $second --lists sorted
deepmerge @first $second --lists
deepmerge @first $second --arrays union
as list arr 0.:int=1
deepmerge @first $list
deepmerge @list $first
deepmerge @first

# flatten
as tree from_json tree/tree.json
as flat flatten @tree areas
to_json @flat
keys @flat
as slashed flatten @tree areas /
to_json @slashed
as colons flatten @tree areas ::
keys @colons
as whole flatten @tree nothing
equals @tree $whole
flatten @none areas

# flatten: what it refuses
flatten @list areas
